title: ep1.2_strawberry.jpg
logline: Mas wants a number: NopeAI's only price is a stuck $86B on the lobby ticker. A strawberry photo strings a conspiracy across the city while his company teaches a machine to think and then hides the thinking. People leave through a new revolving door, the ticker starts to move, and the podium that has faced away all year reaches the top of the hill.

beats.caption: THE CORKBOARD: red yarn runs tower to tower across the city. Behind a taco truck, a man reads seeds as Morse.

lines.text: Strawberry. The next model is called Strawberry.

onscreen: THE CORKBOARD GUY · HAS A THEORY
cues: his last strand ends in a bow on a pot atop the NopeAI spire

beats.caption: On the spire, Mas waters the pot at the end of the yarn and pockets what grew there.
INTRO · the cold-open line reveals the post the city was reading. Then the file card.
onscreen: i love summer in the garden

beats.caption: The want, wordless: the lobby ticker is stuck at $86B; Mas taps it like a gauge. Gerg leaves on sabbatical.

lines.text: If it breaks, don't call. I'll know.

onscreen: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 258
cues: a blank keycap pops off Gerg's laptop; Mas pockets it

beats.caption: Through the window, LUNCHMAS walks a box to the rival lab over a half-built bridge of Mario's draft pages.
onscreen: POST: "deepen my focus on AI alignment"
cues: podium meter 1 of 4: the gold podium at the foot of the hill, facing away

beats.caption: THE PLAN through the jumbotron, voiced by MAON: it reads chunks, not letters. The new one thinks first.
onscreen: WHY IT CAN'T COUNT THE R'S (AND HOW IT LEARNED TO THINK)

beats.caption: Step 4, SHOW THE THINKING, slams a blank shutter on o1's raised pencil. The clang tears the blueprint.
SET-PIECE · HOW MANY R'S? The old model kicks a 2; boos. o1 jogs out past the pilot's open Q* vault.
onscreen: PRO PLAN · PRICE: TBD · COMING SOON
cues: the vault's sticky note still reads DO NOT OPEN. DO NOT EXPLAIN.

beats.caption: o1 thinks through a halftime show. Then the shutter drops, field-sized, and this time it's labelled.
beats.vo: nobody ever asked what i was thinking.
cues: Mario starts On the Dual-Use Risks of Letter Counting; Adelina shreds page one
the FAN CAM circles his head and gives up: THOUGHTS SUMMARIZED.

beats.caption: Maon's summary of the thinking is a sticky note. Mas pockets it.
THE CORKBOARD GUY, on twenty seconds of thinking. Three dots are three days.

lines.text: Twenty seconds? I've never thought about anything for twenty seconds.

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · A banner on his wallpaper; phone face down, unread. His essay. A clock that can't find a number.
onscreen: SEP 17 · ELGOOG PAUSES CHILE DATA CENTER OVER WATER (REPORTED)
"…we will have superintelligence in a few thousand days (!); it may take longer…"
cues: the Ep2 SAFETY COMMITTEE lanyard hangs on the hook, off his neck
THE STACK: 1 unread
style moment (proposed, treatment): the strawberry lock-screen wallpaper

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · The pilot's NONPROFIT door leans on the wall. A new industrial door goes in, where people leave.
beats.real: 2024-09-25 · Rima and two other leaders resign

beats.caption: The door spins into a turbine that powers the lobby. A paper blows in. Class photo #3 has a Rima-shaped hole.

lines.text: We're gonna need a smaller photo.

beats.caption: F3.1 · THE WOODROSE, 2015, Gerg's memory: the place cards. The chairs of those who left dim; his own is empty.
cues: Mas's glass doesn't ripple

beats.caption: On the lobby TV, California's governor vetoes the AI-safety bill. The 1047 head pops off; two stubs grow.
onscreen: "…curtailing the very innovation that fuels advancement…"
cues: MOSWEN pockets NEDIB's pen; the whoosh is Mas's door

beats.caption: MIDPOINT · The revolving door is now a turbine that spins the ticker: investors ride it in, one per wing.

lines.text: I solemnly swear not to fund… which ones?

onscreen: RAIL: OCT 2 · INVESTORS REPORTEDLY ASKED NOT TO FUND RIVALS
cues: a cold $7T pallet comes back: 'a return.'

beats.caption: The ticker rolls from $86B to $157B. Collar #4 pops. Who owns it? His answer ticks the ticker up a dollar.
F3.2 · The odometer runs back to $43.4M and burns its gears. TPOOL, sold to a prepaid-card company. A kazoo.
Nobel week on his monitor. NOTNIH is proud of the student who fired Mas. SIMED plays check against his medal.

lines.text: I'm particularly proud of the fact that one of my students fired Mas Manalt.

cues: Alyi's empty doorway glows behind NOTNIH; Mas slides his glass one inch
podium meter 3 of 4

beats.caption: The one-on-one: Mas calls Gerg at the beach about the keycap. Two long shots. Never about reasons.
cues: a lifeguard unplugs the sandcastle data center; the pier goes dark

beats.caption: Mario's 15,000-word essay: a country of geniuses in a datacenter. It ends well. Don't tell anyone.
onscreen: "a country of geniuses in a datacenter"
cues: the one exit: signposted, with Mas on the far bank

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · The essay unrolls across the Bay and finishes the August bridge. The last paragraph: NOW HIRING.
cues: on the first plank, LUNCHMAS's footprints, and eleven older pairs under them

beats.caption: F3.3 · A pop-up book: the NopeAI bus splits on the hills. The rear half, eleven researchers, is repainted.

lines.text: So I wasn't the first one across.
You're the first one who read it.

cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): the pop-up book, the episode's one full-frame leap

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · A plain fact card. THE PODIUM tops the hill; Nole sits on its step. A glint. Mas clicks a pen.
cues: podium meter 4 of 4: a gold cuff waves
egg: a houseplant with an antenna by the NOZAMA box, its pot reading PLANTAIR

beats.caption: Gerg comes back through the revolving door; it takes him round twice. Mas hands him the keycap. It clicks in.
onscreen: POST: "CONFIRMED: LLMs have indeed reached a point of diminishing returns" · SUCRAM

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · SHIPMAS: a 12-door advent calendar on the company's livestream, Mas in a Santa hat. Door 1: $200.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): the whole run as the company's own stream; the show's rail goes dark
the elf's sleigh runners drift out of step: 'it's a preview.'

beats.caption: Door 12: o3. Its bar punches through the ceiling and skewers the critics: a stamp, a scroll, the corkboard.
THE LINE at OGAL-A-RAM: CEOs queue to pitch the podium's back. Two stacked hats. Nole is already on the step.

lines.text: I'm on the step. You're in the line.

beats.caption: Mas writes a $1M check on a stranger's back. SAMA NOS, only a reflection, holds $100B. Nobody winks.
BUTTON · He drops the check in. Clink. Nothing happens. Then the $100B goes in the gold, and THE PODIUM turns.
cues: music: a low muted-brass drone under the clink; one stop, one hold

beats.caption: DLANOD J. RUMPT: navy suit, long red tie, a thumbs-up. The man who wanted a number is asked for one.
HOOK · The bay is frozen. A strawberry with one bite missing on the ice; a whale-shaped shadow glides beneath.
